## History

John Andrew, locally known as [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md), was hired to paint the village hall as part of a local improvement project. Due to a mix-up with the paint numbers, he painted the building a glaring bright blue with a red roof. Although his work initially shocked the village with its hideous result, public opinion ultimately turned against his family in favor of the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society).

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P2](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0002), [v2 IX A Question of Color P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 IX A Question of Color P4](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0004), [v2 IX A Question of Color P5](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0005), [v2 IX A Question of Color P6](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0006), +23 more_

## Relationships

### [Roger Pye](../character/roger-pye.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/john-andrew--roger-pye.md)

John Andrew is documented as the child of [Roger Pye](../character/roger-pye.md). Their family relation exists within the context of the Pye family, whose household becomes a source of local public friction in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) following a disastrous paint mix-up on the village hall.
